# Evaluation & Benchmarking for LLMs

**Measure language models and LLM apps properly: classic metrics, public benchmarks and leaderboards, LLM judges, error analysis, and open-source eval tools.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 12 steps · 5h 00m of video · Prerequisites: [AI Engineering](ai-engineering.md). [LLMs from Scratch](llms-from-scratch.md) helps for the perplexity step.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/evaluation-and-benchmarking-for-llms/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Run two small open models on three lm-evaluation-harness tasks and write up where their scores differ and why.
- Hand-label 50 outputs from an LLM app, build an LLM judge for the most common failure, and report how often it agrees with you.
- Build a 20-question RAG test set and track RAGAS faithfulness and context recall as you change chunk size.
